title: Set 51

sentences.ko: 위층에서 뭘 하는지는 모르겠는데 누가 농구공을 튀기는 소리 같아. 하필 애 재우려는 시간에 시작해. 그 집도 애들이 있으니까 일부러 그러는 게 아닌 건 아는데, 이제는 밤마다 누워서 그 소리 나기만 기다리고 있어.
sentences.text: I don't even know what they're doing up there, but it sounds like somebody's bouncing a basketball, and it starts right around the time I'm trying to get my kid down. They've got kids too, so I know it's not on purpose, but now I'm just lying there waiting for it every night.

alts.text: No clue what goes on up there, but it sounds like somebody's dribbling a basketball, and it kicks in right when I'm trying to get my kid down. They've got kids too, so I know it's not on purpose, but now I'm just lying there every night waiting for it.

I do not even know what they are doing upstairs, but it sounds as though someone is bouncing a basketball, and it begins right around the time I am trying to put my child to bed. They have children as well, so I know it is not intentional, but I now find myself lying there waiting for it every night.

sentences.note: **get my kid down** 은 아이를 눕혀 재운다는 뜻입니다. 캐주얼의 **kicks in** 은 소리나 증상 같은 게 갑자기 시작된다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 언니가 자기 동네 매물을 계속 보내는데, 더 넓고 더 싸. 반박할 말이 하나도 없어. 그런데 거기로 가면 아는 사람들이랑 다 한 시간 거리고, 매번 운전해서 오가는 건 내가 되겠지. 그래서 계속 봄쯤에 보자고 말해.
sentences.text: My sister keeps sending me listings near her, and they're bigger and they're cheaper, and I don't have one good argument against any of it. But I'd be an hour from everybody I know, and I'd be the one making the drive every time. So I keep telling her maybe in the spring.

alts.text: I keep getting listings from my sister, all near her place, and they're bigger and they're cheaper, and I've got no good argument against any of it. But I'd be an hour from everybody I know, and I'd be the one making the drive every time. So I keep telling her maybe in the spring.

My sister continues to send me listings near her, and they are larger and they are less expensive, and I do not have one good argument against any of it. However, I would be an hour from everyone I know, and I would be the one making the drive every time. So I continue to tell her perhaps in the spring.

sentences.note: **I'd be the one making the drive every time** 은 오가는 운전이 늘 내 몫이 된다는 뜻입니다. **maybe in the spring** 은 거절 대신 시기를 미루며 넘기는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 열한 시에 누워서 영상 하나만 보려고 했거든. 그런데 어떤 사람이 비행기 사고를 설명하는 영상이 나오는 거야. 그런 게 백 개는 더 있고 다 사십 분짜리야. 정신 차려 보니 새벽 두 시고, 나 비행기에 관심도 없어! 영상 하나에서 어쩌다 비행기 사고까지 갔는지 아직도 모르겠어.
sentences.text: I got in bed at eleven and I was going to watch one video, and then it's some guy explaining a plane crash, and there's a hundred more of them, and they're all forty minutes long. Next thing I know it's two in the morning and I don't even care about planes! I still don't know how I got from one video to plane crashes.

alts.text: So I'm in bed at eleven, gonna watch one video, and then it's some guy breaking down a plane crash, and there's a hundred more of them, and they're all forty minutes long. Next thing I know it's two in the morning and I don't even care about planes! Still no idea how I got from one video to plane crashes.

I went to bed at eleven intending to watch one video, and then I came across a man explaining a plane crash, and there were a hundred more of them, and they were all forty minutes long. Before I knew it, it was two in the morning, and I have no interest in planes at all! I still do not understand how I went from one video to plane crashes.

sentences.note: **Next thing I know** 는 정신 차려 보니 어느새 그렇게 돼 있더라는 말입니다. 캐주얼의 **breaking down** 은 하나하나 뜯어서 설명한다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 유튜브 보다가 시간 다 날린 얘기

sentences.ko: 고양이 침대를 사 줬어. 좋은 걸로 40달러쯤 주고. 그런데 근처에도 안 가. 그게 담겨 온 상자에서 자는데, 그 상자가 침대 바로 옆에 있어. 남편은 시간을 좀 주라는데 벌써 한 달이야. 답은 나온 것 같아.
sentences.text: We got the cat a bed, a nice one, like forty bucks, and she won't go near it. She sleeps in the box it came in, and that box is sitting right next to the bed. My husband says give it time, but it's been a month, so I think we've got our answer.

alts.text: Forty bucks we spent on a cat bed, a nice one, and she won't go near it. She sleeps in the box it came in, and that box is sitting right next to the bed. My husband keeps saying give it time, but it's been a month, so I think we've got our answer.

We bought the cat a bed, a nice one, roughly forty dollars, and she will not go near it. She sleeps in the box it arrived in, and that box is sitting directly beside the bed. My husband says to give it time, but it has been a month, so I believe we have our answer.

sentences.note: **give it time** 은 시간을 두고 지켜보자는 말입니다. **we've got our answer** 는 더 볼 것도 없이 결론이 났다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 여섯 시에 가려고 했는데 점심을 너무 많이 먹어서 이 배로는 못 뛰겠어. 그래서 오늘은 건너뛰려고. 뭐라고 하기 전에 미리 말하는데, 맞아, 월요일에도 딱 그렇게 말했어.
sentences.text: I was going to go at six, but I ate way too much at lunch and I'm not running on that, so I'm skipping it. And before you say anything, yes, that's exactly what I told you Monday.

alts.text: Six was the plan, but I ate way too much at lunch and I'm not running on that, so I'm skipping it. And before you start, yes, that's exactly what I told you Monday.
I had intended to go at six, but I ate far too much at lunch and I am not running on that, so I am skipping it. And before you say anything, yes, that is precisely what I told you on Monday.

sentences.note: **I'm not running on that** 는 그렇게 잔뜩 먹은 상태로는 뛸 수 없다는 말입니다. **before you say anything** 은 상대가 지적하기 전에 먼저 인정하고 들어가는 표현입니다.
sentences.situation: 운동 가려다 말게 된 핑계 대기

reviewed: 1번 formal: text 의 "I don't even know" 에서 even 이 빠져 뜻이 약해졌습니다. "I do not even know" 로 되돌렸습니다.
2번 formal: 마지막 줄만 "So I keep telling her" 로 말투가 캐주얼하게 남아 있었습니다. "So I continue to tell her" 로 맞췄습니다.

3번 formal: "and then it is a man explaining" 처럼 이야기할 때 쓰는 현재형이 격식체에 그대로 남아 시제가 어긋났습니다. "and then I came across a man explaining ... and there were a hundred more of them, and they were all forty minutes long" 으로 과거로 통일했습니다.
4번 casual: "My husband's all give it time" 의 be all 은 젊은 층이 쓰는 인용 표현이라 따옴표 없이 읽으면 문장이 끊긴 것처럼 보입니다. "My husband keeps saying give it time" 으로 바꿨습니다 (text 의 says 와도 겹치지 않습니다).
